column4: Group adm; member user (and syslog) can read many log files in /var/log
column6: Membership is listed in this entry; removing it takes from user the documented right to read system logs, so something becomes impossible (S2.2-2).

column4: Group cdrom; member user gets access to optical drives
column6: Removing the entry removes user's documented access to CD-ROM drives through this group, so something becomes impossible (S2.2-2).

column4: Group sudo; member user may run any command as any user via sudo or pkexec
column6: Membership gives user the right to become superuser, which S2.2-15 requires to be recorded.

column4: Group dip; member user can make dial-up connections with pppd, pon, poff
column6: Removing the entry takes from user the documented ability to start ppp dial-up connections (ppp is installed), so something becomes impossible (S2.2-2).

column4: Group plugdev; member user can access removable devices without fstab entries
column6: Removing the entry takes from user the documented limited access to removable devices, so something becomes impossible (S2.2-2).

column4: Group users with member user; documented only as a traditional shared user group
column6: Documentation names no right the group grants; which files or rules use it on this machine is not established (filesystem query failed).

column4: Group lpadmin; member user can add, modify and remove printers (CUPS system group)
column6: CUPS is built with system groups root and lpadmin; removing the entry takes printer administration from user, so something becomes impossible (S2.2-2).

column4: Group scanner; member saned (network scanner daemon) gets access to scanner devices
column6: Documentation requires saned in group scanner; removing the entry makes scanning through saned impossible (sane-utils installed), so S2.2-2 applies.

column4: Group sambashare; member user can create Samba user shares (nemo-share)
column6: Usershare creation is granted to members of this group; removing the entry makes folder sharing by user impossible (S2.2-2).
